channel.description: Latest articles from New York Daily News (nydailynews.com)

item.title: After potentially playing in last game at MSG, LeBron James hopes he holds ‘small snippet’ of importance with NY fans
item.description: In the loss, James recorded 22 points, six assists, five rebounds and a steal.

item.title: On anniversary of trade, Lakers’ Luka Doncic flirts with triple-double in loss to Knicks at Garden
item.description: New York City will always be a small part of the Luka Doncic trade that stupefied the NBA.

item.title: Trevor Noah takes shot at Nicki Minaj, Trump in Grammys opening monologue
item.description: The 68th Grammy Awards opened with host Trevor Noah delivering a monologue that included jabs at Nicki Minaj and President Trump.

item.title: Kennedy Center will close on July 4 for two years of renovations
item.description: President Trump said Sunday the John F. Kennedy Center for the Performing Arts will close for two years starting on July 4 for renovations to the “dilapidated” venue, pending approval of the hand-picked board that he chairs.

item.title: Knicks extend winning streak to 6 games with convincing win over Lakers
item.description: This time last year, the stakes were different — and so were the results.

item.title: Three years later, man arrested for anti-gay hate crime in Harlem train station
item.description: A 25-year-old man was arrested Sunday for punching and hurling a homophobic slur at a man in a Manhattan subway station more than three years after the startling confrontation, according to police.

item.title: Knicks’ Karl-Anthony Towns reflects on 6th, ‘real special’ All-Star nod
item.description: "It’s special. This one’s a real special one for sure," said Towns. "It’s better to be getting the win against the Lakers. I feel better about that right now than the All-Star thing, but as time goes, I’ll be able to digest it and understand the importance of it. "But right now, I’m just happy we got the win."

item.title: Bad Bunny makes history with Grammys win for Album of the Year
item.description: Bad Bunny made history Sunday night when “Debi Tirar Mas Fotos” became the first ever all-Spanish-language record to win Album of the Year at the Grammys.

item.title: Asking Eric: Friend wants to ‘divorce’ friend’s boorish husband
item.description: Dear Eric: I’ve been good friends with a woman for about five years now; we live abroad. However, I am not and never have been a huge fan of her new husband. item.title: Knicks’ Landry Shamet delivers another 3-point barrage in win vs. Lakers
item.description: Landry Shamet finished 8-of-13 from the field, including 6-of-10 on 3-pointers, in Sunday's win over the Lakers.
